rearEnvelope.topology: single V-folded airmail back with connected kraft shoulders and central point; no detached lip, horizontal top band, or duplicate fold seam

pocketStage.scaling: Rear, front pocket, cards, and Memo use one shell width and one uniform scale. The 402 pt viewport uses a 370 pt shell with 16 pt screen margins; compact height caps the composition at 270 pt while actions retain 44 pt hit targets.

rule: The rear layer, its integrated visible V point, front pocket, state card, and contextual Memo are one open-envelope coordinate system. The connected point must be visible between card and pocket; both kraft shoulders must connect to narrow airmail rails; no detached triangle or horizontal airmail band may appear above the card; no layer may be replaced by a whole-screen screenshot.
